intentionalChanges.field: Updated for B24 floor-based signed integer sampling; seeded changes approved by user. Then: Brush dots and stamps are now generated on the GPU from hashed randomness: same distribution and ink (within ~2% of 2.3.0), different seeded realization. Approved by user 2026-10-27. Then: density-invariant dot footprint (F01); these scenes render at density 1, where fine brushes are now ~4x lighter, matching density 2. Then: strokes are drawn on the default paper tooth (strength 0.5), seeded by brush.seed(). Then: the paper tooth is removed (approved 2026-10-28); strokes render as before it was added.

intentionalChanges.wash: Fill and wash layers are rasterised on the GPU into a half-float log-space mask instead of Canvas2D (docs/rendering.md): no 8-bit quantisation, GPU antialiasing. Same polygons; sub-pixel edge and quantisation differences only.

intentionalChanges.watercolor: Fill and wash layers are rasterised on the GPU into a half-float log-space mask instead of Canvas2D (docs/rendering.md): no 8-bit quantisation, GPU antialiasing. Same polygons; sub-pixel edge and quantisation differences only. Reference pixels in legacy-watercolor.rgba.gz regenerated. Then: the watercolour fill model replaces Hobbs' classic layering as the only fill style (docs/rendering.md, approved 2026-10-28): 7 drawn layers, no erase circles or border capsules, a composite with blurred silhouette, coffee-ring rim, granulation, pigment separation and wet-in-wet. Reference pixels regenerated.
